segments.text: Celia! You look... different. Thom... forty years ago, you said something.

segments.speaker: Thom / Celia
segments.text: Celia, look, it was forty years ago. I said something stupid. But you can't just destroy the world over it. I'm not destroying the world, Thom. I'm just leaving.

segments.speaker: Captain / Barbie
segments.text: Barbie, talk to me. Is the link stable? We're reading deep neural feedback. Signal is eighty-four percent.

segments.speaker: Captain
segments.text: Hold it there. Don't let her drop.

segments.speaker: Thom / Celia
segments.text: We had a future, Celia. You wanted a future without this. You couldn't even look at my hand.

segments.speaker: Captain / Resistance
segments.text: They're breaching the perimeter! Hold the line! Protect the link!

segments.speaker: Thom / Celia
segments.text: Celia, please! I'm sorry about your hand! It wasn't about the hand, Thom. It was about you.
